brief:
An Israeli airstrike struck a vehicle in the Gaza Strip on Sunday, killing a man and his teenage daughter, according to health officials in the enclave. Mohamed Abu Selmia, head of Al Shifa Hospital—Gaza's largest medical facility—confirmed the deaths to Al-Monitor. The identities of the victims were not immediately disclosed by officials.

The strike marked the latest casualties reported amid ongoing military operations in Gaza. Al Shifa Hospital, where Selmia serves as director, has been a key source of casualty information for international media and humanitarian organizations monitoring the situation in the densely populated territory.

title: Israeli airstrike kills man and daughter in Gaza Strip
